sits.notes: Please note it will be in the 40's this Saturday! Please dress appropriately!Bring a cushion, something for underneath it like a yoga mat.  We meet near the welcome center on the opposite side of the parking lot from the art museum. We sit in the center grass at the top of the hill.
sits.details:
This is a thirty minute silent meditation. In past years we stopped sitting outside when the weather was less than pleasant for most. To push on the edges of our practice, and to learn to sit with some discomfort, we have chosen to sit through the late fall and winter unless the situation becomes actually dangerous (like a blizzard or lightning storm). Dressed in the right clothing it is actually not a big deal to sit for 30 minutes in the cold or wet, and it is really good practice. If we are serious about this practice and we give some consideration to the conditions the Buddha and original Sangha sat in, then we won't have any problem with this!
 We usually have some fellowship - Dharma discussions before and after, nice but you are welcome to come and just meditate with us. Meditating in community and in the reality of the world is a great way to get used to conditions being not under our control. Also meditating outside connects us with the natural world. text 919-306-9495 if you have a difficulty finding us.
